name: MultiModalQA: Complex Question Answering over Text, Tables and Images
description: MultiModalQA is a challenging multi-hop question answering benchmark requiring joint reasoning over heterogeneous modalities: semi-structured Wikipedia infobox tables, textual Wikipedia passages, and paired images. Comprising 29,918 questions, answering each question requires synthesizing information across multiple modalities (e.g. text-image, table-text, or table-image-text), serving as a gold standard for multimodal reasoning.
